aliases: CVI Dom Maklerski sp. z o.o.
decision_note: Warsaw-based private debt manager (senior, junior, unitranche, mezzanine; equity only exceptionally); a real active lender, but debt-led and not VC, so outside the cz-vc pilot.

evidence.publisher: CVI Dom Maklerski sp. z o.o.
evidence.quote: CVI provides flexible financing solutions for medium-sized companies to meet a wide range of capital needs.

evidence.publisher: CVI Dom Maklerski sp. z o.o.
evidence.quote: CVI manages portfolios for 8 investment funds with a total AUM of EUR 1,1 mld.
Greenberg Traurig advised private debt funds managed by CVI and Flexam Invest in connection with the financing in the form of senior secured bonds issued by CTL Logistics.

CVI provides companies with a full spectrum of solutions including senior, junior, unitranche, mezzanine and structure equity, with typical tickets ranging from EUR 2 to 25 million (and more with co-investors).

analyst_notes: Quick S1/E4 dossier. investor_type set to pe as the closest closed-list type for a private-credit fund manager; the business is debt-dominant (own site: 'leader in the private debt market in Central Europe'; CVCA self-reported 2020 profile: direct lending, senior debt, mezzanine, equity only exceptionally), hence E4. The old domain cvi.eu now redirects (http) to cvi.pl; https://www.cvi.eu fails with a TLS hostname mismatch. AUM EUR 1.1bn is from the undated homepage (as_of = retrieval date); the 2025-05-29 GT release says nearly EUR 1bn. Ticket EUR 2-25m is CVI's boilerplate quoted in the GT release. EBRD project database lists a commitment to CVI Private Debt Fund II SCA SICAV-RAIF (board review 2024-11-06), not cited here. The CTL Logistics deal is a bond financing, recorded under investments only as dated activity.
